paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: The figure is a single-series vertical bar chart titled “Recall@10” that illustrates an ablation study by showing Recall@10 values for a full method (“Ours”) and three variants with specific components removed (“- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking”). The horizontal axis contains the four category labels in left-to-right order: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” with the text angled slightly; there is no explicit x-axis label. The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale without an explicit axis label, spanning from 0.1 to 0.4 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals (0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4), and faint horizontal gridlines align with these ticks. The “Ours” bar is colored orange and reaches approximately 0.35. The three ablation bars are colored blue: “- critiquing” reaches about 0.29, “- scoring” reaches about 0.17, and “- ranking” reaches about 0.235. The bars are presented as a single group (not stacked) with no legend shown, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the distinct orange color used for the “Ours” bar.
